### Problem

A site administrator reading a screen's Summary cannot tell what Users+ Pro would add to it. Only Security › Summary shows a Pro feature as a row of its own (Passkeys · Pro · "Users+ Pro adds passkeys…" · Learn about Users+ Pro, `diluxone_users_ui_pro_row()` in `includes/admin-security.php`). Every other Pro preview is a disabled control deep inside a tab, and some are on screens that have no Summary at all, so an administrator who never opens that tab never learns the feature exists. The inventory on `main` (every call of `diluxone_users_ui_pro_choice(s)`, `_pro_control`, `_pro_button`, `_pro_shape`, `_pro_card`, `_pro_row`):

- Access (has a Summary): sign in with a passkey (`login/ways/more`); the sign-in page shapes "Split with a picture" and "On a full background" (`design/login/shapes`).
- Security (has a Summary, with Passkeys only): second step for only some roles (`security/2fa/roles`), an authenticator app (`security/2fa/app`), letting it decide on the e-mail link (`security/2fa/link`), remembering a browser (`security/2fa/remember`).
- Social login (no Summary): the ten more providers (`social/providers/<slug>`), only some roles may use the buttons (`social/general/roles`).
- Account area (has a Summary): adding sections of the site's own (`account/sections/more`), how often a public name can change (`account/handle/cooldown`), keeping it once chosen (`account/handle/locked`).
- User fields (no Summary): asking for the missing required fields after sign-in (`fields/missing/ask`) and letting people skip it (`fields/missing/skip`). Nothing on the screen's first tab mentions it.
- Design (no Summary): the account area with a cover (`design/account/shapes`), any colour (`design/brand/any-color`), the colours from the theme (`design/brand/theme`), which theme colour plays each part (`design/brand/color-map`).
- Network › Membership: "Whoever asks" and "By invitation" (`network/membership/rules`).

Separately, every "Learn about Users+ Pro" link goes to `https://diluxone.com/es/wordpress/users/` for an administrator whose language is Spanish (`diluxone_users_pro_url()` in `includes/admin-ui.php`), a page that does not present Users+ Pro.

### Scope

- The Pro address lives in one constant, `DILUXONE_USERS_PRO_URL` (`https://diluxone.com/wordpress-plugins/users/`), and `diluxone_users_pro_url()` only adds `utm_source`, `utm_medium` and `utm_campaign` to it, with no branch by language.
- Every Pro feature in the inventory has one row in the Summary of the screen it belongs to, drawn by `diluxone_users_ui_pro_row()` as Security's Passkeys row is: its name, the Pro badge, one sentence and the same link. Features that come together may share a row (the two sign-in page shapes; the ten providers).
- Social login, User fields and Design get a Summary tab, first among their tabs and opened by default, in the shape of the other screens' Summary (`diluxone_users_summary_table()`): what the screen has set up now, read from its settings, then its Pro rows. Network › Membership gets its Pro rows where that screen reports its state.
- Each Pro row has a stable `where` key of its own per feature and is gated by `diluxone_users_pro_shown( $where )` (the `diluxone_users_pro_previews` setting and the `diluxone_users_upsell` filter), the same mechanism as the placeholders inside the tabs.
- The Summary stays complete with or without Users+ Pro: every Pro row passes through one documented filter, `diluxone_users_summary_pro_row` (the row, its `where` key), before it is drawn. When Users+ Pro brings the feature it returns the feature's real row (its name, its state and a link to change it, e.g. "Passkeys · On · Change it"), which is drawn in the same place instead of the Pro row; that row is drawn even while the previews are off. The free plugin ships no Pro code and draws nothing but the preview row when the filter is left alone.
- The new tabs go into `tests/e2e/support/screens.ts` and `tests/e2e/COVERAGE.md`; `docs/extending.md` lists the new `where` values.

### Out of scope

- Any Pro behaviour: the free plugin ships no Pro code and names no Pro setting.
- Removing or moving the Pro previews already inside the tabs.
- The listing screenshots and the readme, which #240 retakes after this merges.
- The pages on diluxone.com.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given an administrator whose language is Spanish and one whose language is English, when either opens any "Learn about Users+ Pro" link, then its address is `DILUXONE_USERS_PRO_URL`, `https://diluxone.com/wordpress-plugins/users/`, and carries `utm_source=diluxone-users`, the screen's `utm_medium` and `utm_campaign=free`.
C2: Given the free plugin alone with Pro previews on, when Access › Summary is opened, then it has a Pro row for passkeys and one for the sign-in page shapes, each with the Pro badge and the link.
C3: Given the free plugin alone with Pro previews on, when Security › Summary is opened, then it has Pro rows for passkeys, the authenticator app, the second step for only some roles, letting it decide on the e-mail link and remembering a browser.
C4: Given the free plugin alone with Pro previews on, when Account area › Summary is opened, then it has a Pro row for sections of the site's own and one for how a public name may change (how often, and keeping it once chosen).
C5: Given the free plugin alone with Pro previews on, when User fields, Social login or Design is opened without a tab, then a Summary tab is open first, reports that screen's current setup, and has Pro rows for: asking for missing required fields after sign-in and letting people skip it (User fields); the ten more providers and only some roles (Social login); the account area with a cover, any colour, the colours from the theme and the theme colour map (Design).
C6: Given a network with Pro previews on, when Network Admin › Membership is opened, then "Whoever asks" and "By invitation" appear as Pro rows where the screen reports its state.
C7: Given `diluxone_users_pro_previews` off, when every screen above is opened, then no Pro row and no new Summary row mentions Users+ Pro.
C8: Given `diluxone_users_upsell` answering false for one Summary row's `where` key and nothing hooked on `diluxone_users_summary_pro_row`, when that screen's Summary is opened, then that Pro row is gone and the rest stay.
C9: Given a callback on `diluxone_users_summary_pro_row` that returns a row with a state for one `where` key (as Users+ Pro does for a feature it brings), when that screen's Summary is opened, with the previews on and with them off, then that row is drawn in the Pro row's place with the callback's name, state and link, with no Pro badge, and the other rows are unchanged.
C10: Given `docs/extending.md` on the branch, when it is read, then it documents `diluxone_users_summary_pro_row` (its arguments, what it returns, an example) and lists every Summary row's `where` key.

### Criticality

Normal
